description: This file defines a route component in a Qwik-based frontend application. It implements a redirect from the root path '/' to '/recipes', preserving any query parameter 'q'. It also exports head metadata for the page.

methods.name: useRedirect
methods.description: A route loader function that redirects from '/' to '/recipes', passing along the 'q' query parameter if present.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: A Qwik component that performs no rendering as it only handles the redirect logic.
